description:
Check whether a piece of evidence supports a specific claim. Returns "supported", "contradicted", "conflicted", "insufficient", or "unknown", with the underlying probabilities. The distinction between "not supported" and "contradicted" is the reason to use this rather than reading the evidence yourself.

It judges one claim against the evidence you give it. It does not search for evidence, and it cannot detect that you omitted the decisive passage.

evidence.description: The evidence to judge it against. Quote rather than paraphrase.

name: jev_check
title: Check a claim against evidence
